semanticPurpose: D1-ORDER-001의 전량 정상 수령 뒤 15초 동안 네기마 식사와 생맥주 음주를 번갈아 표시하는 츠키오카 식사·음주 2프레임 bundle이다.

sourceReferences.role: user-designated approved full-screen source for Tsukioka identity, camera, palette, and pixel treatment
approved waiting R2 identity, directly front-facing chair, FHD coordinate, and alpha-boundary anchor
user-authorized post-receipt two-frame eating/drinking state, topology, and exclusion contract

generation.mode: two precise-object-edit generations bundled as one user-authorized animation state
generation.promptSummary: From approved waiting R2, generate one negima-eating frame without beer and one draft-beer-drinking frame without negima; preserve Tsukioka identity and directly front-facing chair.
postProcess: two auto-key border chroma removals with sampled magenta, soft matte, and despill
nearest-neighbor normalization to 291×690 for eat-negima and 300×690 for drink-draft-beer
same FHD anchor center x=1085 and top y=215 for both frames
isolated checkerboard APNG review, looping the two frames every 1200 ms

contains: two alternating frames: eat-negima then drink-draft-beer

excludes: table, plate, tray, coaster, order mat, any background scene, other customer, or extra chair
text, quantity, check, gauge, panel, button, badge, or any UI
both food and drink in a single frame
chroma-key background, cast shadow, or reflection
approvalQuestion: D1 츠키오카의 전량 수령 뒤 식사·음주 bundle 하나를 검토한다. 두 프레임이 정면 의자·정체성·FHD 배치를 유지하는지, 네기마 먹기와 생맥주 마시기가 서로 다른 프레임으로 명확한지, 투명 경계가 적절한지 확인한다. 승인 전 재조립·runtime 애니메이션 연결은 하지 않는다.
